name: net_reconnect_shadows_outside_activation_control
description: PRIVATE SINGLE-CYCLE NEGATIVE CONTROL, not recovery acceptance. Preserve the original exact 5/5/5 HP17/max20 setup, native input corridor, pre-pause sampled outside geometry, original processes/session/pins/epoch/progress and automatic Friend1 pause/rejoin checks. Enable only PREPARE=1 and SPAWN_TRACE=1 at boot. Require two complete post-rejoin native censuses 5/0/5 with no extra or dead native enemy rows, exact survivor identities/HP/progress, fresh Friend1 load4/transition3 and zero death/tombstone history. Natural5/5/5 FAILS this negative control; no forced resync or replay treatment is invoked. Require current-load host activation float4 before/after endpoints outside all seven current BOXes on three distinct peer geometries, with raw bytes and no uncertain edge. No input after corridor completion. These are non-atomic sampled endpoints before and after rejoin, NOT a continuous outside interval, stable point, native predicate result or causal proof. Stop after expected-state/identity/death evidence; no later cycles, timer-based readiness or treatment acceptance. Original runner/save/process guards and pause/reconnect bounds remain.
